finalText:
I took a fresh screenshot of the whole canvas after my last edits, and all five posters still look right on the Ideas canvas (`.design/ui/Ideas.tsx`).

- **01 · Dark-mode season posters:** three fanned poster cards (Kick-off, Derby, Final day) under "The season, after dark."
- **02 · One-page match recap:** the 3–1 score card, goal timeline and stat bars under "The whole match, one page."
- **03 · Animated logo sting:** four frames of the crest animating, plus its motion curve, under "Two seconds that say it's us."
- **04 · Self-updating sponsor wall:** sponsor tiles by tier, marked "Live", with "New" tags, under "A thank-you wall that keeps up."
- **05 · Volunteer sign-up page:** a landing page with shifts and Sign up buttons, under "Give us one Saturday."

In the full-canvas picture, the studio toolbar covers the bottom of 05 (the description line and footer). My earlier close-up of that poster rendered properly through the headline; its last two lines haven't shown up in any picture yet.

My only edits after the earlier screenshots were the canvas's header comment and its description in the studio. Neither one changes what the posters show.
